sources.title: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017-StrixHalo-GGUF - Hugging Face
sources.snippet: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 cut down to fit one AMD Ryzen AI Max+ 395 (Strix Halo) box with 128 GB of unified memory, aiming at a 64K context. The full model has 384 routed experts per layer and needs about 230 GB even at the smallest standard quants.

sources.title: ISA-DASLab DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 GSU RCO GGUF local model
sources.snippet: The ISA-DASLab DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 GSU RCO GGUF is a locally runnable AI model intended for private use on personal computers. It is an LFM-style variant from DeepSeek released under the GGUF format, and it works with the Stratat client desktop application to let you run inference entirely on-device.
